description: Video clips of the live game for devlogs, store pages and press kits. action start keeps a rolling recording of the last 15 s; save writes what it has (between about 7 and 15 s) to .debuff/captures/<name>.mp4 (WebM in browsers that can't record MP4) and keeps recording; stop ends it. Play or drive the game with game_input between start and save. Live mode only: clips record real time. The human posts; never post anywhere yourself.

name.description: File name for save, without extension (letters, digits, - and _). Default clip-<timestamp>.

name: game_clip
title: Record a clip
